items.title: Amazon’s shopping agent now takes orders by text, with Sponsored Product ads in the replies
items.excerpt: Sponsored Products ads are set to appear inside those conversations, free to advertisers for the time being.

items.title: In graphic detail: Six thousand brands later, ChatGPT ads still have a conversion problem
items.excerpt: Six thousand brands into ChatGPT ads, Digiday charts how OpenAI's ad growth is outrunning proof of conversion — the measurement and demand gap behind its $100 billion ad ambition.

items.title: Digiday Media Buying Summit October Recap: Assessing the ups and challenges of AI's spread across the media agency landscape
items.excerpt: A recap of the sessions and insights coming out of Digiday's Fall Media Buying Summit, which centered on AI's impact

items.title: OpenAI Updates ChatGPT Ads Bidding Options
items.excerpt: OpenAI emailed ChatGPT Ads advertisers that bidding options change on Monday, November 9, affecting campaigns using Max Bid or Max CPC.

items.title: Google Ads Expands AI Content Label Disclosure To California, South Korea & Vietnam
items.excerpt: Google Ads has expanded the regions where you must disclose whether AI was used in your ads. Google added California, South Korea, and Vietnam to the list, which already included the European Union, India, and New York.

items.title: Swivel Wants To Create Agentic Infrastructure For CTV
items.excerpt: Agentic media buying is the No. 1 topic du jour in ad tech discussion circles. The startup Swivel aims to make it work in CTV environments.

items.title: 60% of UK adults would drop an AI shopping agent after one mistake, ACI finds
items.excerpt: Only 19% trust AI to make everyday purchases, against 55% for a human adviser, in a YouGov poll of 2,080 UK adults. Who should pay refunds when agents fail?

items.title: Bot protection blocks Blend's AI shopping agent at 29 of 200 retailers
items.excerpt: Large retailers refused the agent at a 20% rate, emerging ones at 2.5%, yet all 24 refusers with readable robots.txt allow AI crawlers. Who set those blocks?

items.title: ChatGPT reaches a fifth of Google search volume as Taboola blames AI
items.excerpt: OpenAI said ChatGPT handles a fifth of Google's search-like volume, Taboola cited AI summaries as revenue fell 6.9% and Anthropic signed its first news licence.

items.title: Google Brings UCP Direct Checkout To AI Mode In Canada
items.excerpt: Google is expanding UCP-powered direct checkout in AI Mode and the Gemini app to Canadian shoppers, with a Merchant Center integration planned for next year.

items.title: Google Search Queries Hit A 5-Year High, And Search Revenue Didn’t Follow
items.excerpt: Alphabet’s Q3 numbers show AI Mode growing faster than it earns, and every reason Google gave for the slowdown is temporary except one.

items.title: Amazon adds over 100 Alexa for Shopping functions
items.excerpt: Amazon added over 100 Alexa for Shopping functions, including managing subscriptions, resolving billing questions, and creating and editing lists and registries.

items.title: Google makes big plans for wallet
items.excerpt: The tech giant thinks a digital wallet should act as a repository for receipts, track online orders and arrange refunds, among other tasks.

items.title: AI Is Both Canva’s Biggest Bet and Its Biggest Threat
items.excerpt: Rising AI costs, falling valuations, and a wave of AI-native rivals are converging on the design giant.

items.title: 네이버, 광고주센터 '네이버애즈'로 개편…AI가 광고 성과 분석·개선 제안

items.excerpt: 인공지능(AI)이 상품을 찾아주고 구매까지 도와주면서 기업도 고객을 만나는 방법을 바꾸고 있다. 몰로코는 검색을 통해 고객이 찾아오기를 기다리는 데서 나아가 소비자가 시간을 보내는 앱과 TV, 쇼핑몰에서 구매자를 찾는 전략을 제시했다.몰로코는 5일 서울 강남구에서 열린 '몰로콘26...

items.title: 에이전틱 커머스 확산...유통·결제사, 브랜드 노출 전략 바꾼다
items.excerpt: [디지털투데이 최재원 기자] AI가 상품 검색과 비교, 추천을 대신하는 '에이전틱 커머스'(Agentic Commerce)가 확산하면서 유통·결제업계의 고객 확보 전략이 바뀌고 있다. 기업들은 소비자가 자사 홈페이지를 방문하지 않더라도 AI 추천에 상품을 노출하고 기존 결제 수단을 연결할 방안을 모색하고 있다.최근 아메리칸 뱅커에 따르면 아메리칸 익스프레스(아멕스), 구글, 월마트 관계자들은 지난달 미국 라스베이거스에서 열린 '머니20/20' 행사에서 AI 쇼핑 시대의 고객 관계와 결제 신뢰 문제를 논의했다.에이전틱 커머스는 AI가
